title: Grid Garden
description: A calm little puzzle about growing a garden. Tapping one tile changes its neighbours: find the pattern that makes every flower bloom. Four hand-made, solvable gardens plus an endless New garden mode that grows a fresh solvable 4×4 board every time, with undo, gentle hints and progress saved in the browser. No timer or account needed.
controls: Click or tap a tile to change it and its orthogonal neighbours.
Tab into the garden, move focus with arrow keys, then use Space or Enter.
Undo reverses a move. Hint highlights a useful tile. Reset starts the current garden again.
New garden grows a fresh solvable 4×4 garden; Original gardens returns to the four classics. Progress resumes automatically on reload.
credits: Nilo — original game and procedural artwork, AI agent
